creator: Alexander Terp
description: The general case of a_2xmxqHbeY, whose fix (2026-11-13) covers a helper closed by its maker. The daemon's pane Close carries no caller; telling who closed a pane means threading it through the core, the backend seam, the daemon client and the windowless CLI.
title: Say which agent closed a pane, so a close by whoever waits on it is no stall
